player_prompt.intro:
Sampeyan kuwe Player {player_id} ing sawijining {num_rounds}-round of IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Saben round, mrahane angka antawisipun {min_guess} lan {max_guess}.
Sawise kalih mrahane, target kuwe (2/3)x(rata-rata saka kalih mrahane),
lan juru main sing mrahane paling cedhak karo target menang round kuwe.
Balas karo mrahane Sampeyan ing format '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format ora valid; kirimake tebakan minangka [<number>].

message.round_guesses: Pemain 0 menebak {guess0}; Pemain 1 menebak {guess1}. Mula Targeté: {target}.
